description: Use this when a user needs a deterministic calculation but none of the dedicated tools clearly matches and the calculator_id is unknown. Search 737 calculators from the complete task in English or Chinese, then call run_calculator with the top matching calculator_id and returned input_hints. Do not use this for trivial arithmetic, live data, writing tasks, or when a dedicated typed tool already matches. This tool only discovers; it does not calculate.

category.description: Optional category id to restrict results.

query.description: The complete user task, including known values and units; for example 'compound interest on 15000 at 4.8% monthly for 12 years'.
examples: compound interest on 15000 at 4.8% monthly for 12 years

name: search_calculators

outputSchema.description: Read-only catalogue or schema result used to select a calculation tool.

title: Search calculators
